SEARCH
Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Schnittstelle Npc

public interface Npc
A live handle on one NPC.

Setters take effect immediately for every player who can currently see the NPC — there is no separate "apply" step. Changes are batched within a tick where the protocol allows it, so setting five appearance flags in a row costs one packet, not five.

Threading

Every method here must be called on the main server thread unless its documentation says otherwise. Methods returning a CompletableFuture do their work elsewhere and complete on a background thread, so a continuation that touches Bukkit has to be scheduled back.

Persistence

Setters change the NPC in memory and mark it dirty; they do not write to storage. The engine saves dirty NPCs periodically and on shutdown, and save() forces it immediately. This keeps a script that moves an NPC every tick from turning into a database write every tick.

Lifetime

A handle is invalidated when the NPC is deleted. Every mutating method then throws IllegalStateException; check isRemoved() if a reference may have been held across an administrator's /npc remove.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • setType

      void setType(NpcType type)
      Changes what the NPC is rendered as.

      The client cannot change an existing entity's type, so this despawns and respawns the NPC for everyone currently seeing it. Properties that do not apply to the new type — a skin on a zombie, for instance — are kept but not sent.

      Parameter:
      type - the new type
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if type is null
      IllegalStateException - if the NPC has been removed

    • teleport

      void teleport(NpcPosition position)
      Moves the NPC.

      A move within the same world sends a teleport packet to the players who can see the NPC. A move to another world despawns it for everyone and respawns it for whoever can see it there, because the client has no concept of an entity crossing dimensions.

      Parameter:
      position - the new position
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if position is null
      IllegalStateException - if the NPC has been removed

    • setSkin

      void setSkin(NpcSkin skin)
      Applies an already-resolved skin immediately.

      A player NPC's skin is part of its profile, which the client reads once when the entity appears, so this respawns the NPC for everyone currently seeing it. Nothing happens for non-player NPCs.

      Parameter:
      skin - the skin, or null to fall back to the default
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the NPC has been removed

    • setSkin

      CompletableFuture<Void> setSkin(SkinSource source)
      Resolves a skin source and applies the result.

      Returns immediately; the lookup runs off the main thread and the skin is applied on the main thread once it arrives. The source is remembered, so a later /npc reload re-resolves it.

      Parameter:
      source - the source to resolve, or null to clear the skin
      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing when the skin has been applied, or completing exceptionally if the source could not be resolved
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the NPC has been removed

      CompletableFuture<Void> save()
